links.outcome: Patient understanding score and doctor-patient communication time with plain-language AI-interpreted pathology reports versus original reports
links.effect: Patient understanding rose from 5.23 to 7.98 points (P<0.001); communication time fell over 70%, from 35 to 10 minutes (P<0.001) with interpretive pathology reports.
links.quote: Among 698 pathology reports analyzed, the interpretation through LLMs significantly improved readability and patient understanding.

unlisted_practices: Using GPT-4 to generate templated interpretive pathology reports to reduce doctor-patient communication time

screen.reason: Empirical study evaluating GPT-4-generated interpretive pathology reports used in clinical consultations between doctors and patients, measuring communication time and patient comprehension.
